name: Fill Dataset (Procedure Call)
description: Calls a server-side procedure and loads the result into a dataset. This is the primary way this codebase invokes backend APIs — never invent a fetch/axios/REST payload shape, always use this action.

row.description: Row index to fill when the target dataset is row-oriented, e.g. 0.

args.description: Parameters passed to the procedure, often including other dataset values as filters, e.g. "filterCondition": "[DsPDCListQuickFilter]".
